svg.title: Suvir Duggal: Computer Engineering co-op student at the University of Alberta. Seeking a 4- or 8-month co-op from May 2027.
svg.text: Computer Engineering co-op · University of Alberta
I like work that crosses the hardware/software line: RTL and silicon, firmware on real
boards, and the distributed systems that collect their data. Looking for a 4- or 8-month
co-op from May 2027 in software, embedded, silicon/ASIC or systems.
